register.description: uDMA source address for secured read master. Must be Word aligned.

bitfield.description: DMA SEC JOB SRC ADDR: Specifies source address for secured read master. Source address must comply with bit.26 to enable Sec/Non-Sec accesses, otherwise transactions will be blocked.

register.description: uDMA destination address for secured write master. Must be Word aligned.

bitfield.description: DMA SEC JOB DST ADDR: Specifies destination address for secured write master. Destination address must comply with bit.26 to enable Sec/Non-Sec accesses, otherwise transactions will be blocked.
DMA SEC JOB LENGTH: Resolution - 32 bits/4 bytes Maximum configurable job size - 1 Mega byte (256K Words). (Maximum available size in MEMSS is 1MB).
DMA SEC JOB MODE: 0 - Data movement from External memory to Internal memory/Peripheral 1 - Data movement from Internal memory/Peripheral to External memory.
Secure channel mode 0: Memory Mode 1: Peripheral Mode
DMA SEC JOB START WRCL: Start command for uDMA to start working on secured configured job.
DMA SEC JOB CLEAR WRCL: Clear command for uDMA to stop working and clear configuration.

DMA SEC JOB ACTIVE: Status bit to indicate that DMA is processing a secured job. When this bit is set, SW has written all the job parameters and also provided a start_pulse to HW, and cannot change job parameters without clear_pulse. Job will wait to be executed (indicated by job_in_progress)
DMA SEC JOB IN PROGRESS: 1- sec job is currently in progress and being executed by uDMA

DMA SEC JOB READ WORDS LEFT: number of read words left in sec job. Note: This value would be updated on a read to this register. [UDSSTA1.WRWRDSLFT] is updated on a read to this register This register value shows number of words in 32 bit when field [UDSCFG3.JDIR] is configured '0' else shows number of words in 8/16/32 bit based on the configuration of [UDSCFG3.SMODE] and [UDPERCFG.SWORDSZ] fields
Status vector for IRQ indication for secured DMA IRQ: 2'd0 - DMA done. 2'd1 - DMA Internal bus error occurred. check SEC_STATUS in order to recovers
Bus Error direction 0: Source bus 1: Destination bus Note: Source and destination is determined based on [UDMA_SEC_MODE_CFG.MEM_DMA_SEC_JOB_MODE] configuration

register.description: uDMA secured Status bits in addition to [UDMSSTA] register

DMA SEC PERIPH WORD OFFSET: Number of words left in a peripheral block. Note: This value would be updated only on a read to [UDSSTA] register. This register value shows number of words in 8/16/32 bit based on the configuration of [UDSCFG3.SMODE] and [UDPERCFG.SWORDSZ] fields

register.description: uDMA source address for non-secured read master. Must be Word aligned.

bitfield.description: DMA NONSEC JOB SRC ADDR: Specifies source address for non-secured read master. In case using SAU to define secured memory region 'inside' the non-secured, this channel will allow this.

register.description: uDMA destination address for non-secured write master. Must be Word aligned.

DMA NONSEC JOB LENGTH: Resolution - 32 bits/4bytes Maximum configurable job size - 1 Mega byte (256K Words). (Maximum available size in MEMSS is 1MB).
DMA NONSEC JOB MODE: 0 - Data movement from External memory to Internal memory. 1 - Data movement from Internal memory to External memory.
Non secure channel mode 0: Memory Mode 1: Peripheral Mode
DMA NONSEC JOB START WRCL: Start command for uDMA to start working on non-secured configured job.
DMA NONSEC JOB CLEAR WRCL: Clear command for uDMA to stop working and clear configuration.

When this bit is set, SW has written all the job parameters and also provided a start_pulse to HW, and cannot change job parameters without clear_pulse. Job will wait to be executed (indicated by job_in_progress)
DMA NONSEC JOB IN PROGRESS: 1- nonsec job is currently in progress and being executed by uDMA

DMA NONSEC JOB READ WORDS LEFT: Number of read words left in nonsec job Note: This value would be updated on a read to this register. [UDNSSTA1.WRWRDSLFT] is updated on a read to this register This register value shows number of words in 32 bit when field [UDNSCFG3.JDIR] is configured '0' else shows number of words in 8/16/32 bit based on the configuration of [UDNSCFG3.NSMODE] and [UDPERCFG.NSWORDSZ] fields

Bus Error direction 0: Source bus 1: Destination bus Note: Source and destination is determined based on [UDMA_NONSEC_MODE_CFG.MEM_DMA_NONSEC_JOB_MODE] configuration
FIFO WRITE THRESHOLD: In case of write to ext mem, uDMA will reach the threshold and after that will send the data to the ext mem Note: 0(Zero) is not allowed

FIFO WRITE BURST LEN: After uDMA will reached the threshold, uDMA will sent the data in blocks. 0x0 : block size = 4 word 0x1 : block size = 8 word 0x2 : block size = 16 word 0x3 : block size = 32 word
